# Calc

> A local-first calculator PWA built on @niclaslindstedt/oss-framework.
> Calculations run in named sessions: every operation that ends with = lands
> on a commentable tape, sessions save as markdown files (YAML front matter +
> a readable bullet list) to a local folder, Dropbox, or Google Drive, and
> the keypad layouts — basic, scientific, programmer, or your own custom
> modes — are per-session and customizable.

- App: https://calc.niclaslindstedt.se/
- Source: https://github.com/niclaslindstedt/calc
- Framework: https://github.com/niclaslindstedt/oss-framework

## Features

- Sessions: scratch by default, saved by naming them (no save button);
  the working tape is kept on the device (IndexedDB) so history survives a
  reload with no backend connected, and with no backend connected a named
  session is a file on the device too — connecting one moves them into it
- Display: result-first — the answer big on top, the expression under it,
  characters revealing one at a time as they are typed and operators drawn
  as bordered chips (`1 + 2`); a half-typed expression holds the last
  answer, dimmed. Result/expression and keypad label sizes are both settings
  (Settings > Appearance)
- Tape: always visible above the display (last few entries) and scrollable;
  the tape itself and the hairline below it are both drag handles — the tape
  takes whatever share of the screen it is left at, up to the whole of it,
  the calculator sliding out under it rather than shrinking past the floor
  its type and rows need. Entries read result-first with a star in the left gutter; tap
  an entry to copy its value, long-press to copy the expression (or, on a
  chained entry, the whole run folded into one bracketed expression),
  left-swipe or right-click for note/delete
- Clipboard: hold the display for a copy / paste pill — copy takes the
  expression on it, paste takes what the clipboard offers (an expression or
  number verbatim, otherwise the first number found in the text, in either
  locale's separators) and types it onto the expression
- Erase key: one key per layout — `⌫` (tap = backspace, hold = clear the
  expression) while something is typed, `C` (tap = nothing, hold = clear the
  tape) once the display is empty
- Modes: basic / scientific / programmer, per-session, plus user-defined
  modes derived from a base layout; buttons can be hidden per mode
- Keyboard: digits, operators and function names type into the shared grammar
  on any pad (`sqrt(2)+sin(0)` on the basic layout); Enter = `=`, Escape or
  Delete clears
- Brackets: one left open at the end closes itself — `sqrt(3` answers, and
  the tape records `sqrt(3)`. The `×` in front of one is optional too:
  `5(6+6)`, `2π` and `(1+2)(3+4)` multiply
- Sidebar: folders and namespaces for organizing sessions
- Storage: markdown files in a local folder or the cloud; localStorage holds
  settings only, and the unsaved working tape is mirrored to IndexedDB so
  history is not lost on reload
- Themes, installable offline PWA

## Storage format

One markdown file per session under `calculations/`, YAML front matter with
`type: calculation`, `id`, `created`, `updated`, and optional `mode`,
`folder`, `archived`; the body is `# Title` plus one `- \`expr\` = \`result\``
bullet per tape entry with indented note lines, optionally led by ⭐
(starred) and ↳ (continued from the entry above).
